question: Which source-native AusTraits K-system species are associated with historical TRY/AusTraits shared-publication leads, before any independent TRY v7 biological outcome?

source_inputs.source_index_kind: TRY HISTORICAL PUBLIC EXPLORER VERSION 6, NOT CURRENT TRY VERSION 7

eligibility.species_support: Recompute original source-native species medians from all original numeric source values; keep only exactly original 254-system cohort species with genus unambiguous and median>0, without changing tree/tip cohort.
eligibility.source_measurement_eligibility: Positive finite original numeric source records in exact source-native expected units; deduplicate source ID + observation ID + value. Count distinct species-system cells and distinct dataset-ID-observation-ID keys.
eligibility.source_grouping: Strong = fixed Tng_2013 matching author+year publication lead. Weak = separately listed author-only candidate AusTraits source IDs. Never mix into one confirmed shared-publication category.
eligibility.raw_species_ids: Never export named species, source observation IDs or trait measurements.
eligibility.report_grain: Summaries by named trait, plus exact strong/weak source IDs and aggregate family/system counts. No species-level records persisted.
eligibility.original_graph_identity: Require every original K family×trait to have exactly the frozen n_input_species recomputed from source-native median eligibility.

safety.no_change_to_external_validation: 10 families×20 distinct species per trait; at least 10 paired family supports; 4/5 frozen signed traits
safety.provisional_result_type: OUTCOME-BLIND SOURCE PROVENANCE EXPOSURE, NOT ECOLOGICAL SELECTION
